package.name: rebot_b601dm_description
package.description:
Canonical kinematic and collision model for the Seeed reBot Arm B601-DM with the DM parallel-jaw gripper.
One xacro source generates two products from shared macros: the full planning model (MoveIt, cuMotion, robot_state_publisher, USD import) and the 6-DoF SDK driver model (Pinocchio nq == 6). Sharing the arm and wrist macros is what keeps the two from drifting; the cross-model FK parity test in test/ is what proves they have not.
